scope: Obstfeld and Rogoff (1996), Chapter 9: nominal price rigidities and basic open-economy models. The Mundell-Fleming-Dornbusch model (exact global saddle path, overshooting, shocks, stochastic and continuous-time versions), Barro-Gordon credibility (one-shot, commitment, reputation as an infinite-horizon repeated game, conservative central bankers, Walsh contracts, the escape-clause peg), Poole's comparison and the optimal feedback rule, policy coordination, and the empirical facts, with the exercises.
source: Maurice Obstfeld and Kenneth Rogoff (1996), Foundations of International Macroeconomics, MIT Press, Chapter 9, pp. 605-658.
